Linux check-mic-permission returns true; elsewhere status is granted comparison. Darwin request screen calls desktopCapturer.getSources then true on promise success; microphone/camera requests only if status not-determined, otherwise equality with granted. Non-Darwin request returns true.
mac handler chooses Privacy_Microphone or Privacy_ScreenCapture systempreferences links.
Recall initialization options: Windows acquires []; Mac/Linux first tries accessibility/screen-capture/microphone, then [] fallback. These are configuration literals, not proof prompts occurred.
Main startup creates windows/registers handlers then calls Recall init. This is static control flow; no app execution observed.
Screenshot calls ys; catch Darwin resets onboarding and rethrows, other OS fallback screenshot-desktop; finally restores preference.
Actual screenshot requests target-size thumbnail and requires a source; permissions probe does not check source existence or thumbnail validity.
nn=darwin and lM=win32. Main renderer imports lM as Hr through export aS (separate original import/export observation).
Mic stream selects default audioinput and invokes getUserMedia audio; input hardware capture is distinct from system audio.
Mac system helper path macExtraResources/audiotee; child wrapper emits PCM/logs. Native helper implementation not inspected.

System stream uses getDisplayMedia branch under feature flag; normal Mac returns empty MediaStream and uses native recorder elsewhere; Windows tries virtual audio device then getDisplayMedia. No Linux support in this V1 system branch.

Startup reads mic permission only. Gate: unknown mic or no screen-granted/attempt -> permissions; mic-granted and screen-unknown after attempt -> quit; else language/mode/survey. DENIED is not excluded by the unknown test.
Permission page has screen and mic rows; screen click marks attempt; on window focus after local click attempt sets didAttemptCapture.
Grant Access invokes request-media-permission; true sets GRANTED, false DENIED then opens relevant Mac Settings; granted button disabled.
Quit page text asks to restart; button sends quit-app only. Existence does not establish runtime reachability or automatic relaunch.
Setup state selects landing, permissions, quit, mode, language, survey views.
